purpose: Redo from review: Mama-san as a close-up POV, as if you're talking to her face to face (the first frame of her VN scene). No lettering.

items.notes: Review note on vn_proto_01 mama_street: I want it to be a closeup pov like you're talking to her face to face.
items.style: photorealistic cinematic film still, neo-noir, 1980s Tokyo city pop mood, neon light and rain, 35mm film grain, shallow depth of field
items.subject: close-up point-of-view portrait at eye level, as if standing face to face with her in conversation: an elegant Japanese snack bar mama-san in her fifties in a dark kimono, hair in a neat bun, a clear umbrella over her head beaded with rain, soft pink and amber neon on her face, she looks straight into the camera with a knowing half smile, head and shoulders, the narrow rainy Kabukicho alley behind her dissolved into neon bokeh
items.composition: wide horizontal composition, her face just left of centre at eye level, the background softly blurred
